requiredRuntime: Node.js compatible with the exact repository scripts (current protected verification uses Node 24.19.0); Git with all exact local objects. No browser, package installation, credentials, network or Python dependency inside this harness.
prerequisites: Root/provider-verified original ZIP retained unchanged, with exact whole-original size/SHA supplied privately in concrete config.

Separate root-owned safe full extraction/CRC intake. Pinned manifest is external to extraction root and contains version1,status PASS,archive{bytes,sha256},checks{wholeOriginalSHA256:true,centralDirectoryComplete:true,allFilesCRCVerified:true},files[{path,bytes,sha256,crc32}]. Paths are archive-relative, CRC is eight lowercase hex characters. Every extracted regular file must be listed and match its SHA/size.

Exact original EA authority source and exact reviewed/published repair authority source, with raw Git blob bytes for all tracked scripts/sounding-line files. The authority HEADs and repair tree are checked, and source files are fingerprinted before and after. Windows text-converted or missing source must be prepared separately; this harness never changes source.

Read-only candidate Git directory with HEAD C16 and all needed commit/tree/blob objects already local. Git no-lazy-fetch and optional-locks0 are forced. Per-case GIT_WORK_TREE points only to fresh private projections; no shared index/ref/source mutation occurs.

Root-prepared preimage projection with exactly the candidate raw Git bytes/modes for every tracked canonical target derived from original capture+R16 record, plus candidate-review.json. Any target absent from candidate must also be absent physically. Non-target original historical media need no materialization or copying.

Fresh nonexistent outputRoot on a volume with measured headroom. Keep original ZIP/extraction/template/source/preimage inputs outside outputRoot, and do not nest outputRoot under an input. Root must budget full original-stage copies, closed-stage copy, encrypted raw segments, three publication ready/preimage journals and final canonical output. No cleanup, hardlinks, retries, overwrite, sparse changes or storage reclamation is performed.

Independent source review and exact helper/configuration pins before execution. All concrete paths, manifest SHA, contractDigest and published repair SHA must be filled. The template refuses execution with missing values.
expectedCountsAre: Native-reported expectations until independently checked against whole verified body; not an existing cloud ZIP proof and not product acceptance.
phases: Verify ZIP whole hash, pinned trusted intake, every extracted file, original failed journal, exact plan/capture/record/source tuple, complete generic tuples, actual typed media/alias closure and all auxiliary file conservation.

Copy complete original stage unchanged into an original C16 preimage projection; invoke original EA and repaired unchanged strict publishers with separate fresh journals. Both must reject exact UNREFERENCED_OUTPUT before any promotion and preserve stage and canonical bytes.

Copy the entire original stage byte-for-byte into a fresh raw/original sibling in a second C16 preimage projection; copy only actual required JSON/media through production copyDeclaredCaptureFile, keeping original working-directory identity, JSON/witness/report/observation/media bytes and logical paired aliases. Validate actual artifacts and original paired/runtime provenance without an invented database URL.
Run actual raw seal, unchanged encrypted retention and minted verified-file-list boundary on the complete actual bytes. No artifact upload or GitHub output is emitted by this standalone harness.

Inject failure immediately before, then immediately after renaming an existing tracked media target using separate new journals. Each must preserve the original injected error, restore every prior byte/mode/absence, retain raw/stage/encrypted inputs and preserve failed output journals. These are publication development fault injections, not browser/capture retries.

Publish the unchanged closed stage normally using a third fresh journal; validate all media hashes, original paired JSON bytes, aliases, all journey bytes and current canonical artifact rules. Keep external candidate-review unchanged. Recheck all source, input ZIP/extraction, raw/stage/encrypted bytes and candidate HEAD/tree/stage0 tuples.
limitations: This is actual-byte selected-file/publication boundary replay. It does not execute the paired subprocess, browser, app, DB, current capture, independent product review, custody, admission, ordinary verification or qualified seal.
Original paired binding and DATABASE_URL digest are retained as original provenance. No URL is guessed or invented, and no witness JSON is rewritten.
Undeclared original WebMs remain raw diagnostic files. The replay does not assert a specific auxiliary file came from Axe unless independent producer/page linkage proves it.
A diagnostic PASS closes only this actual-output regression proof. Protected successor authorization, fresh whole qualification, product review and landed integration remain separate.
